sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'por_empresa', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT c.name, count(*) AS leads, count(DISTINCT l.campaign_id) AS camps, count(DISTINCT l.month) AS meses, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status='outros') AS outros, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status='fechado') AS fechados FROM campaign_leads l JOIN companies c ON c.id=l.company_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC) x),
 'camp_exemplos', (SELECT json_agg(DISTINCT l.campaign_id) FROM (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign_leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 400) l),
 'hist_sem_empresa', (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_history WHERE company_id IS NULL),
 'gatilho', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname ILIKE '%lead_history%fill%' OR tgfoid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_proc WHERE proname='fn_lead_history_fill_company' LIMIT 1)),
 'politicas_delete', (SELECT json_agg(policyname || ': ' || coalesce(qual,'')) FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename='lead_history' AND cmd='DELETE')
)
